text: Flip many coins and heads never lands perfectly half. Chance leaves a wobble. Even counting all two trillion observable galaxies, one vote each, that wobble remains. The counting floor is the quietest signal a perfect count could hear, not an instrument. Now turn every survival knob to maximum. The budget still lands about 10,000 to 100,000 times below that floor, a whisper beneath a stadium. The Planck regime is the extreme where quantum gravity, gravity's unfinished smallest-scale rules, should matter. One honest caveat, both bounces sit in the Planck regime treated classically, and the strict chain awaits external theorist review.
